he.text: It is customary for the pious to fast on the day preceding the New Moon; if it falls on Saturday or Sunday the fast is held on the preceding Thursday. Those who fast put on the טַלִּית and תְּפִלִּין. The Reader commences the following—

en.text: It is customary for the pious to fast on the day preceding the New Moon. If the New Moon falls on Sabbath or Sunday the fast is held on the preceding Thursday. Those who fast put on the Taleth and Tephillin. The Reader commences the following—
